mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the completed lymph return route to the arm was most worthwhile: the result brought the separate pieces together and explained their role in preventing fluid buildup.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to attach the collecting vessel directly to the supplied arm was frustrating because the result gave no hint about the required intermediate connection.

surprise.text: I expected the collecting vessel to attach directly to the draining tissue spaces, but those spaces had to be attached to the supplied arm first.

arbitrary.text: The required assembly order felt somewhat arbitrary: the collecting vessel and tissue capillaries seemed physically related, but the game required other connections first.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the finished route connects cellular supply and tissue-fluid balance in a concrete way, although I would hope future assembly orders are clearer.
